{{Quote|The prince. He's alive!|The prisoner|<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref>}}
A '''Mon Calamari''' lived on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] around the year [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]].

==Biography==
During the Battle of Mon Cala, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] along with [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] were overpowered by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and were forced to retreat in the cavern of the [[Coral City/Legends|Mon Calamari capital city]] while the inhabitants of the city were taken prisoners and moved to a prison camp.

While this prisoner and others were transported to the camp, Prince Lee-Char showed up, and told everybody not to loose hope.

The prisoner was later seen fighting the Separatist [[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droids]] along with prince Lee-Char and other Mon Calamari after the Quarren rebelled.

==Skills and abilities==
This Mon Calamari was a very competent warrior in combat. He was seen jumping onto the head of an incoming [[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droid]] and used his [[spear blaster]] to melee the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] until it was destroyed.
